title: A Discord-style refresh
items: Phones: the emoji, GIF and sticker pickers open where your keyboard would be, and the keyboard no longer pops up on its own. Tap the emoji button again to go back to typing.
Phones: picking an emoji keeps the picker open so you can add a few in a row.
Phones: the message box has a cleaner look, with a rounded send button and no scrollbar, and the ⋯ button tucks away while you type.
Phones: profiles slide up from the bottom with big Message, Call and Video buttons. Drag them down to close.
PC and browser: a new frame with one panel and a rounded corner, your account bar floating across the bottom left, quieter highlights, a flatter message box and thin scrollbars.
The built-in Zuno stickers are gone. Stickers your servers upload are still there, and old messages that used a Zuno sticker still show it.
